# Parsedown

Bundled upstream version: **1.8.0** (MIT license).

Source: https://github.com/erusev/parsedown/releases/tag/1.8.0

`Parsedown.php` and `LICENSE.txt` are unmodified upstream files. No Composer
installation or runtime download is needed.

To update, replace these two files from the desired upstream release and update
the version here. OPRCast-specific heading anchors live in
`system/modules/ParsedownRenderer.php`; safe mode and strict heading syntax are
configured in `system/modules/Markdown.php`. Run `php tests/run.php` after updates.
